# AST-GREP

> Find Code by Syntax

ast-grep(sg) is a fast and polyglot tool for code structural search, lint, rewriting at large scale.

## Table of Contents

### Guide

- [Quick Start](https://ast-grep.github.io/guide/quick-start.md): Learn how to install ast-grep and use it to quickly find and refactor code in your codebase. This powerful tool can help you save time and improve the quality of your code.
